Normally each number should appear about 12 times in 100 draws, 7 at 21 is too frequent, time to pull back; 39 and 49 at 5 are too sparse, time to top up. Do not chase what is too frequent, do not abandon what is too sparse, pulling back to the middle is where this draw is worth playing. Last draw 26/121 drew 2, 8, 11, 35, 43, 47, head prize was unclaimed. Top 3 picks: 39, sparsest, sharpest pull back to the middle after topping up; 49, equally sparsest, topping up the sparsest interval; 1, intersection of tail-1 and interval 1-10, key to balancing cold and hot. Too frequent to pull back, too sparse to top up, the calculated numbers, sum in reasonable zone. 2 groups: 3,12,24,36,39,48, 1,14,28,38,42,49.

data.zh_hk: 命宮要睇旺衰，唔可以只睇一個宮。近100期7出21次全榜最旺，11、28、31、47各18次，旺氣集中，命宮有主星坐，氣勢要順勢而唔好逆。41至49得104次最弱，疾厄宮受壓，弱宮一定要有人去撐，否則三方失衡。奇306偶294，陰陽算平衡，化祿化忌要一齊睇。第一組7、11、23、36、40、49，7坐命宮帶頭，11化祿落財帛，財氣由旺帶動，23守遷移，36、40補疾厄同田宅，49落福德補最疏嘅大號區。尾數7出77次，7本身就係尾數7嘅代表，旺上加旺，唔好避。第二組5、15、27、34、43、48，5落命宮收返啲旺氣，唔好成組都咁衝，15化祿落財帛，27守官祿，34、43補疾厄同福德，48落田宅補尾數8同大號。31至40得111次偏弱，34正正補返。平均和值144.5，平均跨度34.35，連號率51%，上期26/121開出2、8、11、35、43、47，頭獎冇人中。重點推薦3個號：49號，得5次最冷，落喺福德宮反而係轉機，冷到極點化忌轉化祿；7號，命宮主星，旺氣帶頭；43號，得10次偏冷，落喺後半段令成組唔會頭重腳輕。本期2組：7,11,23,36,40,49、5,15,27,34,43,48。

data.en: The life palace must be judged by strength and weakness, never by one palace alone. Over the last 100 draws, 7 appeared 21 times, the strongest overall, while 11, 28, 31 and 47 each appeared 18 times, so prosperity is concentrated, the life palace has a chief star, and momentum should be followed, not fought. The 41-49 band appeared only 104 times, the weakest, so the health palace is under pressure and a weak palace must be supported or the three directions lose balance. Odd 306 even 294 are broadly balanced, so prosperity and affliction must be read together. The first set 7, 11, 23, 36, 40, 49 puts 7 in the life palace to lead, 11 transforms into prosperity in the wealth palace so wealth is driven by strength, 23 guards the travel palace, 36 and 40 support health and property, and 49 falls in the fortune palace to cover the sparsest large-number band. Tail 7 appeared 77 times, and 7 itself embodies tail 7, so strength on strength should not be avoided. The second set 5, 15, 27, 34, 43, 48 puts 5 in the life palace to pull back some of the excess strength so the whole set is not too aggressive, 15 transforms into prosperity in the wealth palace, 27 guards career, 34 and 43 support health and fortune, and 48 falls in property to cover tail 8 and the large numbers. The 31-40 band has only 111 appearances and is weak, and 34 fills it exactly. Average sum 144.5, average span 34.35, consecutive rate 51%, last draw 26/121 drew 2, 8, 11, 35, 43, 47, head prize unclaimed. Top 3 picks: 49, with only 5 appearances the coldest, yet falling in the fortune palace it becomes a turning point, where extreme cold turns affliction into prosperity; 7, chief star of the life palace, leading with strength; 43, with only 10 appearances on the cold side, falling in the second half to keep the set from being top-heavy. 2 groups: 7,11,23,36,40,49, 5,15,27,34,43,48.

data.zh_hk: 抽咗三張大阿爾卡那：過去位抽到「命運之輪」正位，現在位抽到「隱者」逆位，未來位抽到「星星」正位，三張牌正逆唔同，晶格共振完全唔同，成晚嘅能量就係由呢三張牌帶住走。命運之輪正位，輪要轉，過去停滯嘅嘢要轉動，經牌陣互化，化出暗碼；隱者逆位，藏唔住，唔好再等，經晶格變形，化出伏兵；星星正位，光要亮，未來要有希望，化出結果。第一組2、13、22、31、39、47就係過去牌組，2係命運之輪轉動嘅起點，13係輪轉到中間嘅轉變，22係輪停一停嘅等待，31係輪壓住嘅壓力，39係輪轉到底之後爆出嚟嘅伏兵，47係輪轉完之後嘅光，收尾要旺。第二組6、18、29、38、41、49就係現在加未來牌組，6係隱者藏唔住之後嘅基礎，18係隱者行返出嚟嘅平衡，29係隱者變星星嘅轉折，38係星星未全亮之前要忍嘅暗位，41係星星開口嘅光，49係星星最亮嘅結果，冷到盡頭反而係新開始。重點推薦3個號：39號，命運之輪轉到底嘅伏兵；49號，星星正位嘅結果，新開始；47號，命運之輪轉完之後嘅光，收尾要旺。抽出嚟嘅暗碼，100期驗證，和值落合理區，平均和值144.5、平均跨度34.35。本期2組：2,13,22,31,39,47、6,18,29,38,41,49。

data.en: I drew three Major Arcana: the past position drew Wheel of Fortune upright, the present position drew The Hermit reversed, the future position drew The Star upright. Three cards, different upright and reversed, completely different crystal resonance, the whole night's energy is carried by these three cards. Wheel of Fortune upright, the wheel must turn, what was stuck in the past must move, through the spread's mutual transformation, yielding hidden codes; The Hermit reversed, cannot stay hidden, do not wait any longer, through crystal deformation, yielding ambush; The Star upright, the light must shine, the future must hold hope, yielding the outcome. The first set 2, 13, 22, 31, 39, 47 is the past spread, 2 is the starting point of the Wheel turning, 13 is the change as the Wheel turns to the middle, 22 is the pause as the Wheel stops for a moment, 31 is the pressure as the Wheel presses down, 39 is the ambush bursting out after the Wheel turns to the end, 47 is the light after the Wheel finishes turning, the ending must be strong. The second set 6, 18, 29, 38, 41, 49 is the present plus future spread, 6 is the foundation after The Hermit can no longer hide, 18 is the balance as The Hermit walks back out, 29 is the turning point from Hermit to Star, 38 is the dark spot to endure before The Star is fully bright, 41 is the opening light of The Star, 49 is the brightest result of The Star, where reaching the extreme cold becomes a new beginning. Top 3 picks: 39, the ambush after the Wheel turns to the end; 49, the outcome of The Star upright, a new beginning; 47, the light after the Wheel finishes turning, the ending must be strong. The drawn hidden codes, 100-draw verification, sum in reasonable zone, average sum 144.5, average span 34.35. 2 groups: 2,13,22,31,39,47, 6,18,29,38,41,49.
